task: human validation of the image-reconstructed forms gold
gold_corrected_by: Claude Opus (large multimodal model, not among the evaluated engines)

sample.selection: reproducible uniform random sample over scored fields

result.agreement: full; both annotators independently marked every sampled field correct

notes: Two annotators reviewed the same random sample independently, against the form images, in the browser tool (scripts/validation/gen_review_html.py; see docs/img/human_validation.png). One discussed non-error: marked-option answers are not encoded uniformly across forms. An alternative shown as 'Alternativa A (X)' can be encoded two equally valid ways - the full option text as the answer, or the option label as the field with the 'X' as the answer (one consent form takes the second, recording seven checklist items each as a 'V'); the consensus was that the reconstructed value is correct, the correction prompt simply not standardizing which encoding it uses. This is a representation choice, not a wrong value. The raw per-field annotations and the field values are not redistributed here: the underlying forms gold derives from XFUND (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) and is fetched from source; this file records only PII-free counts.
